description: Source code implementing a Skia event tracer class and initialization function, interfacing with Chromium's tracing system.

classes.name: SkChromiumEventTracer
classes.description: A class implementing SkEventTracer for Chromium's Skia integration, providing methods for category enabling, naming, adding, and updating trace events.

methods.name: getCategoryGroupEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether a category group is enabled based on its name.

methods.name: getCategoryGroupName
methods.description: Retrieves the category group name from an enabled flag.

methods.name: addTraceEvent
methods.description: Adds a trace event with specified parameters and returns a handle.

methods.name: updateTraceEventDuration
methods.description: Updates the duration of a trace event identified by its handle.
